In this role, you will help ensure the optimal operation, availability, and reliability of automated warehouse systems and intralogistics equipment. You will work in a high-tech environment where automation, precision, safety, and continuous improvement are essential. Together with your colleagues, you will make sure that ASML's logistics operations continue to run efficiently and with minimal downtime. Wie zoeken we? You are a hands-on technician who enjoys working in a dynamic and highly automated environment. You approach technical problems in a structured way and remain calm when equipment unexpectedly stops or priorities change. Because you will work closely with internal and external customers, colleagues, and suppliers, clear communication is essential.
